aboutH2: Twelve Mile Recovery: Comprehensive Addiction Treatment in St. Catharines, Ontario
intro: Twelve Mile Recovery is a premier addiction treatment center located in St. Catharines, Ontario, offering a holistic and evidence-based approach to recovery. Our mission is to provide compassionate, trauma-informed care that empowers individuals to overcome addiction and achieve lasting sobriety.

At Twelve Mile Recovery, we offer a range of treatment options tailored to individual needs, including inpatient rehab programs, virtual therapy, addiction counseling, and aftercare support. Our services integrate mindfulness practices, martial arts therapy, nutritional coaching, and cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) to foster physical, emotional, and mental well-being.

pillars.title: A House on Lake Street in Downtown St. Catharines
pillars.body: This listing is the Lake Street residence at 125 Lake Street, a renovated house on an ordinary residential street in downtown St. Catharines. Inside there are two lounges, one with a fireplace, a shelf of books and board games, plus a full kitchen with an island where residents cook and eat together. Bedrooms are private or shared. The same program also runs at Rodman Hall, a restored heritage estate on Twelve Mile Creek with gardens and woodland trails. Between the two houses the program holds 29 people, so groups stay small.

pillars.title: Six Weeks of Reintegration, Then Aftercare for Life
pillars.body: Residential treatment is followed by six weeks of virtual reintegration with the same counsellor you had in residence, and it is included in the cost. After that, every graduate becomes an alumni member with no application and no expiry date. Members can join two virtual sessions a week through the centre's private app, which also has group and one-to-one video sessions, check-ins and a family space. If someone slips, the team recommends going back into a reintegration plan, and sober living for a few months is one of the options they suggest.

pillars.title: Run by People Who Have Been Through It
pillars.body: Twelve Mile Recovery was started by Chris Howe and Joanna Duarte, who are both in long-term recovery and now co-direct the program. The team they built mixes clinical training with lived experience. It includes a Medical Director, a clinical psychologist, registered social workers, a registered psychotherapist, certified addiction counsellors and registered practical nurses, along with chefs, fitness coaches and yoga and breathwork teachers. Physicians oversee every treatment plan, and every client gets pharmacogenetic testing to guide prescribing.

location.heading: Twelve Mile Recovery in St. Catharines, Ontario
location.intro: Twelve Mile Recovery is in St. Catharines, the largest city in the Niagara Region, with its Lake Street house close to downtown and its second residence, Rodman Hall, on Twelve Mile Creek. Toronto is about an hour and a quarter away by the QEW, Hamilton about 45 minutes, and Niagara Falls, Welland and Grimsby are each around 20 to 25 minutes by car.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Twelve Mile Recovery cost?
faqs.a: The centre's own FAQ puts a 6-week inpatient stay at $20,000 to $30,000. The final figure depends on the program, how long you stay and which room you choose, and admissions goes through every fee on the first call. Six weeks of virtual reintegration and lifetime aftercare are part of the program.

faqs.q: How long does the treatment program last?
faqs.a: The length of treatment varies based on individual needs. Programs typically range from 6 to 12 weeks of residential care, with extended aftercare support available for long-term recovery.

faqs.q: Does Twelve Mile Recovery offer detox?
faqs.a: No, Twelve Mile is not a detox facility, and it asks for at least 72 hours of sobriety before you arrive. If you need medical withdrawal management first, the team arranges a referral to a medical withdrawal service and holds your place while you complete it.

faqs.q: Where is Twelve Mile Recovery and how do I get there?
faqs.a: This residence is at 125 Lake Street in St. Catharines, in Ontario's Niagara Region. It is about an hour and a quarter from Toronto along the QEW and about 45 minutes from Hamilton. Call or text admissions before you travel so they can plan your arrival.

faqs.q: Does Twelve Mile Recovery have more than one location?
faqs.a: Yes. The program runs in two houses in St. Catharines: the Lake Street home on this listing and Rodman Hall, a heritage estate on Twelve Mile Creek. The centre says both run the same program with the same counsellors and clinical team, and together they hold 29 people.

You move into six weeks of virtual reintegration with the same counsellor you had in residence. After that you become a lifetime alumni member, with two virtual sessions a week through the centre's private app and no expiry date. Families also get their own space in the app.

faqs.q: Is this a private, paid centre? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, Twelve Mile Recovery is a private facility, so OHIP does not usually cover it. The centre does not bill insurers directly, but it gives detailed receipts you can submit to your extended health or employer plan. Financing is available through Medicard.

faqs.q: What types of addiction does Twelve Mile Recovery treat?
faqs.a: Twelve Mile Recovery provides treatment for alcohol addiction, drug addiction (including opioids, stimulants, and prescription drugs), co-occurring mental health disorders, and behavioral addictions such as gambling or gaming.

faqs.q: What treatment programs are available at Twelve Mile Recovery?
faqs.a: We offer inpatient rehab programs, virtual therapy, addiction counseling, aftercare support, and holistic therapies such as mindfulness, martial arts therapy, and nutritional coaching.

faqs.q: Is Twelve Mile Recovery’s approach evidence-based?
faqs.a: Yes, we integrate evidence-based therapies like Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT), and trauma-informed care alongside holistic healing techniques to ensure comprehensive recovery.

faqs.q: Cost of Treatment at Twelve Mile Recovery
faqs.a: The cost of treatment at Twelve Mile Recovery varies based on the type of program, length of stay, and level of care needed. Factors that influence pricing include: 1.Inpatient Rehab Programs: Pricing depends on the duration (6, 9, or 12 weeks) and included services like therapy, accommodations, and holistic treatments. 2.Virtual Therapy & Outpatient Services: Costs vary based on session frequency and therapist qualifications. 3.Aftercare & Continued Support: Some services may be included in the initial program cost, while others require additional fees. 4.Insurance & Payment Plans: Insurance coverage and flexible payment options may be available to help manage costs. For exact pricing details, contact Twelve Mile Recovery or call their admissions team for a confidential consultation.
